name: Northshire Abbey
summary: Northshire Abbey trains new defenders in Northshire Valley, among Elwynn Forest's northern foothills. Rebuilt after the First War, it is the spiritual heart of the Brotherhood of Northshire and a leading school for those answering Stormwind's call.

sections.title: A Legacy of Faith and Ruin
sections.body: Clerics from Lordaeron came south centuries ago to spread the Holy Light and founded the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics and their abbey. The monastery soon became part of kingdom life, caring for the sick and tending to the young Guardian Medivh during his years in a coma. In the First War, brigands and the Orcish Horde attacked it repeatedly, and the abbey was destroyed. After the Alliance of Lordaeron liberated the region in the Second War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol helped rebuild the sanctuary and refounded its protectors as the Brotherhood of Northshire.

sections.title: The Training Grounds
sections.body: Northshire Abbey trains volunteers, militia recruits, and novices who hope to defend Stormwind. Its Main Hall, Hall of Arms, and Library Wing house instructors in martial, arcane, and holy arts, while scouts and rogues train in the outer yards. The Knights of the Silver Hand keep watch, but peace remains fragile. Kobolds overrun nearby mines, aggressive wolves prowl the orchards, and Defias Brotherhood agents stalk the valley roads. They steal ancient scrolls and sacred librams from the abbey's archives.

faq.q: What is the Brotherhood of Northshire?
faq.answer: The Brotherhood of Northshire is a religious order of clerics, priests, and paladins based at Northshire Abbey. Clerics from Lordaeron founded it centuries ago, and Archbishop Alonsus Faol re-established it after the First War to train faithful defenders and preserve sacred scripture.

faq.q: Why was Northshire Abbey destroyed in the First War?
faq.answer: During the First War, the abbey was important to Stormwind's defenses and faith. Orcish forces incited human brigands to attack, and after the half-orc Garona was briefly held captive there, a great Horde assault leveled the holy grounds. The abbey lay in ruins until the Alliance drove out the orcish clans and rebuilt it.

faq.q: Why are there Defias bandits and kobolds outside the abbey?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin protecting distant borders, leaving outlying regions poorly guarded. Kobolds have infested the local gold mines, while the Defias Brotherhood takes advantage of the gaps to rob travelers, harass local vineyards, and raid the abbey's library for arcane tomes and holy relics.

faq.q: What is the connection between Northshire Abbey and the Deadmines?
faq.answer: During the First War, the ogre chieftain Turok stole the sacred Tome of Divinity from Northshire Abbey and retreated into the Deadmines. Sir Anduin Lothar led an expedition into the depths to recover it, became trapped, and was rescued by a royal party that returned the tome to the abbey.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, Northshire Abbey is where your journey begins, and where the kingdom's resilience and devotion welcome every recruit who takes up arms.
For a paladin, Northshire carries the legacy of Archbishop Alonsus Faol and the early clerics whose sacrifices laid the foundation for the Knights of the Silver Hand.
